screened_holds.name: ACS / Coravel Alcalá Data Center Campus (MAD1)
screened_holds.finding: CNMV-hosted ACS issuer H1 presentation page 9 explicitly names the Alcalá Coravel project and says construction is underway. Cover page 1 is dated July 29, 2026. This is a dated named-project current-status statement, not a measured work/start day; June 30 is not assigned from the financial reporting period. No source is admitted while locator identity remains unresolved.
date_caveats: The page is a recent-orders portfolio slide and comparable earlier ACS reports also describe construction in progress. The current named textual status is materially stronger than an aggregate construction financial category, but no newly dated physical milestone or photo-capture date is inferred.
Footnote 'Announced in July 2026' marks the Richland Meta and Berlin NTT bullets, not Alcalá. The footnote is not used as an Alcalá work date.

June 2 ACS educational visit article says students visited the named project, but gives no independent dated construction activity in text. It is contextual only; its video was not downloaded or treated as dated imagery.
screened_holds.identity_scope: Dragados primary project page identifies ACS Digital & Energy as client, a 67,160-square-metre parcel, MAD1 campus and phased expansion model. Coravel, Iridium, ACS Digital & Energy, Dragados/Turner delivery and MAD1 are one Alcalá campus candidate, not phases or independent sites. Capacity, budgets and roles are not normalized.

screened_holds.decisive_next_evidence: A public operator site map/address or municipal permit naming the ACS/Coravel/Iridium Alcalá project and exact parcel, followed by a reusable source-specific locator.

February 2026 ISO certification and June news on other sites are not construction evidence.
screened_holds.date_caveat: 06.26 in Totalbud's index is month precision for indexed completion coverage, not an invented June work day or a fresh active-build observation.
screened_holds.scope_caveat: All three buildings would remain one campus; the completed first building is excluded. No new campus geometry is proposed.
